summary: Option C dead end. The Vitis base_platform xilinx_vck190_base_202410_1 does NOT ship a prebuilt Linux Image / rootfs.cpio.gz. Its sw/.../xrt/image/ directory contains only boot.scr (a u-boot script that loads image.ub from external storage) but NO kernel/rootfs. v++ -p with only --package.sd_file=host.elf (no kernel_image/rootfs override) ran sysroot+qemu_addressing+ext4 image stages, then FAILED with FileNotFoundError on sd_card.img during sd_card_resize.py step — because there's no kernel/rootfs source to populate the EXT4 partition. The platform expects the user to bring their own PetaLinux Image + rootfs, exactly the path T0043 retry2 already pursued.
blocker: find /tools/Xilinx/Vitis/2024.1/base_platforms/xilinx_vck190_base_202410_1 -name 'Image' -o -name 'rootfs.cpio.gz' -o -name 'image.ub'  returns NOTHING. Only boot.scr exists. The platform is a BARE platform — Linux image is the user's responsibility.

v3_artifacts_partial.vpp_package_v3.log: coord/reports/T0043/vpp_package_v3.log — shows v++ -p reached EXT4 sd_card image creation step then FileNotFoundError on sd_card.img during resize
v3_artifacts_partial.package_v3/sd_card/: directory has only BOOT.BIN + boot.scr + host.elf + a.xclbin (no Image, no rootfs)
v3_artifacts_partial.package_v3/launch_hw_emu.sh: references sd_card.img which was never created

human_ack_reasons: Option C is not viable: Vitis base_platform does not include a prebuilt Linux image
Custom PetaLinux + Option A (modify boot.scr to root=/dev/mmcblk1p2) is the only remaining auto-path
Or Option D: DEFER measurement to camera-ready / on-board
remaining_options_for_orch: (A) Option A revisit: edit the custom PetaLinux boot.scr / kernel cmdline to use /dev/mmcblk1p2 (or another correct partition). Requires petalinux-config kernel boot args + petalinux-build re-run (~30min) then re-package + re-emu. Estimated 1-2h.

(B) Statically link host.elf with libxrt/libadf — eliminate dependency on libxrt at runtime — combined with using rootfs.cpio.gz as initramfs (no sd_card mount needed). Requires extra v++ -p flag --package.kernel_command (or similar) to set initramfs path. Estimated 1-2h experimental.
(D) DEFER: keep T0042 analytic 160 us with [AIE-SCHED-EST] label as paper-ready number; T0043 measured pursuit awaits on-board VCK190 (camera-ready) or PetaLinux boot-arg expert fix.
